name: app-icon-button
title: AppIconButton + AppIconButtonSize enum

public_api.constructor:
AppIconButton({
  required IconData icon,
  AppIconButtonSize size = AppIconButtonSize.md,
  Color? color,
  VoidCallback? onPressed,
  String? tooltip,
})
public_api.enum: enum AppIconButtonSize { sm(36), md(44), lg(52) } // size in pixels

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Hover feedback: subtle background highlight via opacity or color change (NOT scale)
Press feedback: scale 0.95 via AnimatedScale with disableAnimations guard
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Size enum has sm(36)/md(44)/lg(52) pixel values
tooltip passed to Tooltip widget for accessibility
Disabled state: opacity 0.5 and onPressed null
completion_summary: Implemented AppIconButton with sm/md/lg sizes, tooltip, hover opacity 0.9, press scale 0.95, disabled opacity 0.5
